name: Mozoncillo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Mozoncillo (the aqueduct on red, trees and a wavy bend on white).
history: Mozoncillo adopted its arms and flag officially on 29 September 2006, published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León on 26 February 2007; the flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, formed of three equal horizontal stripes, green above, white in the centre and blue below.

features.role: Mozoncillo arms — the aqueduct on red, trees and wavy bend on white
